todos.content: Read db.md and backend.md component rules

implements: type-level spine for all contracts above
produces: exported types every route + UI file imports
do_not: use `any` for any field the plan typed
let UI files import from route files or vice versa

consumes: POST /admin/bundles/create requestShape: bundle_type, discount_tiers, discount_type, enabled, items, name
PUT /admin/bundles/update requestShape: bundle_id, bundle_type, discount_tiers, discount_type, enabled, items, name
[create-bundle/discountCodeBasicCreate] consumes: discount type, tiers, product ids
[create-bundle/discountCodeBxgyCreate] consumes: discount type, tiers, product ids
[update-bundle/discountCodeBasicUpdate] consumes: Shopify discount node id, updated tiers
[update-bundle/discountCodeBxgyUpdate] consumes: Shopify discount node id, updated tiers
produces: [create-bundle/discountCodeBasicCreate] produces: Shopify DiscountCodeNode id and code string for percentage or flat bundles
[create-bundle/discountCodeBxgyCreate] produces: Shopify DiscountCodeNode id and code string for BXGY bundles
do_not: pass a literal/placeholder GID to any Shopify op
call a bound op only to discard its returned id
provision Shopify side-effects outside the DB transaction without a rollback path

consumes: [add-bundle-to-cart/cartLinesAdd] consumes: cart external id, selected variant merchandise ids
[add-bundle-to-cart/cartDiscountCodesUpdate] consumes: cart external id, bundle discount code string
produces: [add-bundle-to-cart/cartLinesAdd] produces: updated cart with new line items
do_not: fall back from a resolved live.<field> to the raw DB column it shadows
accept caller-supplied ids without validating shape

produces: idempotent DB writes per the capability each trigger drives
ON CONFLICT on every dedup-keyed insert
do_not: early-return when a declared signalField is empty

consumes: calls GET /admin/bundles — responseShape: bundles, next_cursor, total_count
calls GET /admin/products/search — responseShape: next_cursor, products, total_count
produces: sends POST /admin/bundles/create — requestShape: bundle_type, discount_tiers, discount_type, enabled, items, name
sends PUT /admin/bundles/update — requestShape: bundle_id, bundle_type, discount_tiers, discount_type, enabled, items, name
do_not: send a placeholder/sentinel for a reference column the plan declares NOT NULL
omit a UI affordance for a nullable-with-purpose column
store a variant id where a product id is required

consumes: calls GET /widget/bundles — responseShape: bundles, next_cursor, total_count
calls POST /widget/bundles/add-to-cart — responseShape: cart_external_id, discount_applied, status
for ANY response field shaped live.<field>, USE that field for selection/cart/submit
produces: sends POST /widget/bundles/add-to-cart — requestShape: bundle_id, cart_external_id, selected_variant_ids
do_not: build a gid://shopify/ProductVariant/<id> from anything not returned by backend as variant id
enable a CTA whose preconditions the plan declares
